insurance.description: Protect your livestock investment with comprehensive insurance coverage schemes.
insurance.contactProviders: Contact insurance providers for policy details and claim procedures.

livestockScheme.name: Livestock Insurance Scheme
livestockScheme.description: Insurance coverage for cattle, buffalo, sheep, goat, pig and poultry
livestockScheme.coverage: Death due to accident, disease, natural calamity
livestockScheme.premium: 3.5% of sum insured for cattle & buffalo

pmfby.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
pmfby.description: Crop insurance scheme that also covers fodder crops
pmfby.premium: 2% for food grains, 5% for cash crops
pmfby.subsidy: Premium subsidy for small & marginal farmers

applySteps.step1: Visit nearest bank branch or insurance company office
applySteps.step2: Submit application with livestock health certificate

helpline.title: Emergency Helpline
helpline.description: Get immediate assistance for livestock health emergencies and veterinary consultations.

guidelines.g1: Call immediately if livestock shows severe illness symptoms
guidelines.g3: Note symptoms, temperature, and recent changes
guidelines.g4: Follow veterinary advice until professional help arrives
guidelines.g5: Keep emergency contact numbers easily accessible

helpline.tipDescription: For non-emergency queries about VETRA app usage, livestock management, or scheme applications, you can also reach out through our regular support channels during business hours.

about.title: About VETRA
about.subtitle: Veterinary Trait Extraction & Analysis System
about.version: Version 1.0.0 | Powered by AI & Computer Vision
about.missionDescription: To empower livestock farmers and veterinarians with cutting-edge AI technology for accurate, real-time trait extraction and analysis, supporting better livestock management decisions and improving agricultural productivity across India.
about.techAI: AI-Powered Analysis: Advanced computer vision algorithms for precise measurements
about.techMobile: Mobile-First Design: Optimized for smartphones and tablets
about.techOffline: Offline Capability: Works without internet connectivity
about.techCloud: Cloud Sync: Automatic data synchronization when online
about.techSecurity: Data Security: End-to-end encryption for farmer data protection

instantExtraction.title: Instant Trait Extraction
instantExtraction.description: Body length, height, girth measurements in seconds

dataManagement.title: Historical Data Management
dataManagement.description: Track livestock growth and development over time

schemeIntegration.title: Government Scheme Integration
schemeIntegration.description: Direct access to subsidies and insurance information

about.teamDescription: VETRA is developed under the National Digital Livestock Mission in collaboration with leading agricultural universities, AI research institutes, and the Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India.
about.acknowledgmentDescription: Special thanks to thousands of farmers, veterinarians, and livestock experts who contributed to the development and testing of VETRA across different regions of India.
